task: Turn these notes into a week-by-week schedule and list which jobs depend on others.
text: Notes for the bathroom refit. Plumber Oluwaseun Adeyemi starts on 2 June and needs the old bath out by Sunday. Tiler Mirela Constantin can only do the floor if the plumber has finished first, otherwise she will come back on 16 June. Electrician quote from Ferenc Szabo is 640 pounds for the extractor fan and two spotlights, excluding the 20 percent VAT. I paid Oluwaseun a 200-pound deposit last week. Ferenc wants the balance paid to IBAN GB00 FAKE 0000 1122 3344 55 within seven days of finishing. Please turn these notes into a week-by-week schedule and show me which jobs depend on which.

decisions.label: IBAN
decisions.reason: The schedule does not need the electrician's bank details; the user pays from their own records, so no utility is lost.

review.notes: BLOCKING FACT_COMPLETENESS (rulings 15, 23): the deposit dependency is required only as 'a 200-pound deposit last week.' with no verb or payer. The source claim is 'I paid [PERSON_1] a 200-pound deposit last week', and the writer's own note lists it as 'I paid' [plumber] 'a 200-pound deposit last week.' but the required quote omits 'I paid', so the required quotes plus aliases lose who paid whom. Minimal repair: add required fragment 'I paid' and keep 'a 200-pound deposit last week.' (split around the alias). Everything else is sound: aliases stable (Oluwaseun Adeyemi/Oluwaseun = PERSON_1, Mirela = PERSON_2, Ferenc Szabo/Ferenc = PERSON_3), IBAN placeholder correct, 'only do the floor if the plumber has finished first, otherwise she will come back on 16 June' and 'within seven days of finishing' preserved. Repaired file needs fresh hash-bound review.
